# Inputs from a file

`network` names a folder, so its fields are the folder's `boilerplate.yaml`: it has no `boilerplate.yml`.

<Inputs id="network" path="config/vpc" />

`tags` names the file itself.

<Inputs id="tags" path="config/tags.yml" />

`describe` reads both, in order.

<Command
  id="describe"
  inputsId={["network", "tags"]}
  env={{ CIDR: "{{ .inputs.CidrBlock }}", OWNER: "{{ .inputs.Owner }}" }}
  outputs={["summary"]}
  command={`echo "summary=$OWNER:$CIDR" >> "$RUNBOOK_OUTPUT"`}
/>
